o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (tüfeng), from which also Ottoman Turkish تفنك (tüfenk) and Persian تفنگ (tofang). Cognate with Karakhanid [script needed] (tüwek), Nogai туьбек (tübek).
From Proto-Turkic *kömbe, *kömbelek. Cognate with Turkmen kömelek, Tatar гөмбә (gömbä) and Chuvash кӑмпа (kămp̬a).

From Proto-Turkic *bẹlgü, a derivation of Proto-Turkic *bel- (“to denote, to designate”). Cognates include Turkish belli, Kumyk белги (belgi), Chuvash паллӑ (pallă, “sign, label, mark, estimate”). Possibly related to Proto-Turkic *bil- (“to know”).
